title: Laboratory Operations
subtitle: Luck Lab; Bliss-Moreau Lab, UC Davis
body: Lab Manager Assistant in the Luck Lab, then Junior Specialist in the Bliss-Moreau Lab at UC Davis. I supported laboratory workflows, participant coordination, data-integrity practices and researcher training. B.S., Quantitative Psychology (neuroscience emphasis), UC Davis, 2020; Regents Scholar.
note: References: Dr. Steven J. Luck · Dr. John Kiat.
